## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what users encounter and what this change makes happen.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and results. Separate fixtures from actual site/model calls. For UI changes, include English/Chinese screenshots and tested widths. For media changes, include sanitized source identity/time and remaining limitations.

## Scope and dependencies

Mention new permissions, dependencies/licenses, changed data handling or release implications. Never include API keys, cookies, private media URLs or recordings you cannot redistribute.
